# Claims Lens

> Claims Lens is a denial-management work queue for US medical practices. It imports insurer payment files (X12 835 remittances), matches them to the claims the practice sent (X12 837P), turns every denied line into a task with a plain-English reason, the denied amount and the appeal deadline, and closes the task automatically when a later payment arrives. It is a portfolio demo with fictional data.

Who it is for: billing staff and billing managers at physician practices, and revenue-cycle teams evaluating denial workflows.

## Key pages

- [Live demo and sign-in](https://claims.leixue.dev/): one-click sign-in as a biller or a billing manager; about 200 days of fictional claims, reset nightly.
- [Denial codes in plain English](https://claims.leixue.dev/codes/): every claim adjustment reason code (CARC) and remittance advice remark code (RARC), with common causes and the next step. One static page per code, e.g. [CARC 197](https://claims.leixue.dev/codes/carc-197.html) and [CARC 16](https://claims.leixue.dev/codes/carc-16.html).
- [EDI file inspector](https://claims.leixue.dev/#/inspect): paste or drop an 837P or 835 and read it segment by segment with balancing checks; runs in the browser, no sign-in.
- [How it works](https://claims.leixue.dev/#/about)
- [Source code](https://github.com/lei-xue/claims-lens)

## What it does

- Reconciles each 835 claim and service line against the submitted 837P: billed, allowed, paid and every adjustment.
- Work queue sorted by appeal deadline, with overdue items first; views for mine, unassigned, waiting on payer and closed.
- Per denial: plain-English reason and next step, assign, notes, a corrected replacement claim (frequency 7) or a drafted appeal letter, and recording the outcome.
- Managers see team workload; write-offs over $500 and reopening closed work need a manager.
- Analytics: denied versus recovered dollars by reason, denial rate by insurer and by month, win rate.

## Notes

- All patients, the practice and the insurers are fictional.
- Code explanations are original plain-language text reviewed against the official X12 definitions; the official wording is at https://x12.org/codes.
- Stack: React and TypeScript, a Hono API on Node, PostgreSQL.
